v1_applicability: Mainline v1 rom/usb/classes/rndis; affects every target that loads rndis.class and cdceth.class from disk (seen on raspi-aarch64 20261029, reproduced on pc-x86_64 20261104).

build: kernel-usb-classes-rndis, pc-x86_64, x86_64-aros-gcc 10.5.0, at 95e15bb5d6: no warnings or errors in the rndis files

kernel-usb-classes-rndis, raspi-aarch64, clang 20.1.0 (project raspi-aarch64 toolchain), at 95e15bb5d6: rndis.class.c compiled with no warnings; pre-existing -Wformat warnings in debug.c and if_urndis.c, which the patch does not touch; the final link needed the builtins library from the toolchain's lib directory, because configure's default LLVM version (11.0.0) gives a non-existent lib/clang path; AArch64 module produced (sha256 1fa54897...)
validation.runtime: official 20261104 pc-x86_64 live CD, QEMU TCG, qemu-xhci, hot-plugged usb-net: stock rndis.class binds the RNDIS interface; with the patched class loaded first, the device goes to cdceth.class

limitations: no raspi-aarch64 runtime test of the patched class
RNDIS-only device and forced RNDIS binding not runtime-tested
network traffic over the resulting cdceth binding not tested on x86_64
only other configurations and their base interfaces are checked; cdceth.class also considers alternate settings, to be discussed in review
evidence: private: docs/evidence/pi-network-20261104 in the Dockbar workspace
local_workaround: pool rpi-1 SYS:Pool/start picks SYS:Pool/netdb or SYS:Pool/netdb-rndis by the bound class (both variants, 2026-11-04)
next_action: Follow PR #2098 review. When a Pi nightly with the merged fix is installed, the pool netdb-rndis fallback can stay as harmless or be removed after checking.
